blurb: Guests board the Captain JP III, a dinner boat with three decks and capacity for up to 600 passengers. The boat offers climate-controlled enclosed decks for dining and open-air decks for strolling or dancing. Cruises include live music, food prepared aboard, drinks from full-service bars, and scenic views of the Hudson River.
